en: “Hehe. Are you familiar with the surroundings yet?”
“You can ask me about anything!”
“Is something wrong?”
“I see you're starting to get used to everything. That's great!”
“You have to relax sometimes.”
“Let me know if you need any help!”
“There's no better combination than beer and meat!”
“Hehe. Wait till we're alone together... We can do something naughty.”
“Can you teach me to grill the patties next time?”
“I'll keep practicing beating eggs, so I can at least make sure there are no shells.”
“Do you want to drink tonight?”
“I'm want to thank you... for so many things... I'm serious.”
“You can act cute with me sometimes too. Now have a good rest!”
“Hehe. Remember to lock your door... Or you can come find me later.”
“I want to be closer to you.”
“We can go shopping next time. There are so many places I want to show you!”
“You look very handsome—That's how you'll always be in my eyes.”
“If you feel sad, you can always talk to me about it—”
“I got some good booze today. Do you want to have a few drinks tonight?”
“Sometimes... we can be together at night?”
“I feel a little bored...”
“How should I change my mood...”
“My thoughts are a mess right now...”
“Haa... M-My body feels warm...”
“Erm... My body... I feel an itch...”
“...Are you gonna do something to me?”
“Ohhh... This is a little embarrassing.”
“They can't see me like this—”
“I only dress like this for you...”
